summary: Hand-built server/mcpclient/skill list, search, category, leaderboard, and daily commands using custom multi-block JSON-LD extraction, replacing what would have been generated html_extract endpoints.
reason: MCP Market listing pages embed 2-3 <script type=application/ld+json> blocks per page (Organization, WebSite, ItemList for plain listings; CollectionPage/SearchResultsPage wrapping mainEntity.itemListElement for category/search pages). The generator's html_extract embedded-json mode only returns the first matching script block, which is never the ItemList on these pages. Hand-written extraction walks every JSON-LD block and picks the right one by @type.
validated_outcome: 127/127 live dogfood tests passing; live-verified against mcpmarket.com/server, /search, /categories/<slug>, /leaderboards, /daily, /tools/skills, /tools/skills/leaderboard, /daily/skills, /client.
